_comment: AD-5 lock for episode:subagent_conclusion (FR-19, Story 5.3). Two properties, both of which the kind's weighting was chosen to produce and either of which would break silently: a subagent's conclusion must be RETRIEVABLE on its own topic — it is the whole product of a dispatch and must not sink below the raw command noise from the same run — and it must NOT outrank a decision the user authored on the same subject, because a conclusion is one agent's read of a task while a decision is a commitment somebody made. WHAT THIS SUITE DOES NOT COVER, corrected after review found the original claim here false: it exercises KIND_WEIGHTS only. seed.ts writes state and importance from the literal values below and never calls episodeState or episodeImportance, so a kind that forgets to register in src/memory/items.ts still passes this suite and the gate — the state and importance in this fixture are an assertion about ranking inputs, not proof the projection produces them. That half is pinned in tests/subagent-conclusion.test.ts § 'the new episode kind is registered where it must be', which asserts the projected row's state and importance from a real SubagentStop.

items.subject: retry backoff
items.text: Investigated the retry backoff path end to end. The exponential retry backoff never reaches its ceiling because the attempt counter resets inside the catch block, so every failure restarts at the base delay.
Command (test): npm test -- retry backoff ceiling (exit 1)

items.subject: retry ceiling
items.text: Decision: the retry ceiling stays at sixty seconds and is enforced by the caller, not by the retry helper.
